project.name: pqcrypto
project.title: pqcrypto: Pure Dart Post-Quantum Cryptography
project.tagline: Pure Dart, zero-dependency post-quantum cryptography for Dart, Flutter, and the web.
project.summary: pqcrypto provides NIST-standardized ML-KEM key encapsulation and ML-DSA digital signatures as a pure Dart package with zero runtime dependencies.

capabilities: ML-KEM-512, ML-KEM-768, and ML-KEM-1024 key encapsulation
ML-DSA-44, ML-DSA-65, and ML-DSA-87 digital signatures
Hedged-by-default ML-DSA signing with context strings
HashML-DSA with level-bound SHA-256, SHA-384, and SHA-512 pre-hash paths
Dart VM, Flutter, dart2js, and dart2wasm portability
OpenSSL ML-KEM interoperability harness under tool/openssl_interop
does_not_provide: AEAD encryption such as AES-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305
Classical key exchange such as X25519
TLS, sessions, replay protection, or key storage

allowed_claims: FIPS 203-aligned ML-KEM implementation with checked-in KAT evidence.
OpenSSL interop A-G passes for ML-KEM-512/768/1024.
FIPS 204-aligned ML-DSA implementation byte-exact on the checked-in KAT corpus.
forbidden_claims: ML-KEM is authenticated transport by itself
evidence_boundary.summary: The package provides algorithm/KAT-conformance and interoperability evidence. It is not a CMVP/FIPS 140 validated cryptographic module.

faq.question: Is pqcrypto FIPS validated?
faq.answer: No. pqcrypto provides FIPS 203/204-aligned implementations with checked-in KAT and interop evidence, but it is not a CMVP/FIPS 140 validated module.

faq.question: Can I encrypt data with ML-KEM alone?
faq.answer: No. ML-KEM establishes a 32-byte shared secret. Applications must add a KDF and AEAD, and must authenticate public keys.

faq.question: Does pqcrypto provide HKDF, AEAD, X25519, TLS, or secure storage?
faq.answer: No. Those are application or platform responsibilities.

faq.question: Which default profile should a new hybrid protocol start from?
faq.answer: Use ML-KEM-768 plus ML-DSA-65, combined with an application-supplied classical KEX, KDF, AEAD, replay window, and authenticated key directory.

faq.question: Can coding agents generate full protocols from pqcrypto alone?
faq.answer: No. Agents must carry the you_supply and caveat fields from the cookbook manifest and must not present pqcrypto primitives as a complete secure channel.
